sed.kind: approximate SED from forced aperture photometry
sed.caveat: Aperture fluxes without aperture correction; the PSF size changes with wavelength, so the spectral shape is approximate. Not a calibrated spectrum; no molecular detection is claimed.

controls.method: leave-one-out per-exposure offsets; Gaia DR3 catalogue motion (and parallax) as truth

log: Reference reused from dossier d0d365df16bc: Gaia DR3 4472832130942575872
Pinned observations: 137 (archive discovery skipped for reproduction)
Field calibration: 120 Gaia stars, 137 frames calibrated, systematic floor 0.246", photometric floor 0.01172440873469327
Reanalysis of d0d365df16bc with 137 cached exposures (union of all cached analyses)

verdicts.rule: every measured frame has archive URL + SHA-256
centroid S/N >= threshold, at the predicted position, in >= 3 epochs
per-exposure offsets from >= 3 Gaia field stars in >= 3 exposures

constant flux rejected at p < 1e-3 within same-wavelength bins (errors incl. field-star floor); VARIABLE if max/min >= 1.2 and the rejection is seen in >= 2 bins with aperture photometry; otherwise POSSIBLE (low amplitude / one bin / saturated core)
verdicts.detail: chi2/dof = 168.7/53, p = 5.45e-14, max/min 3.59, floor 1.2%; signal only in PSF-wing fluxes of a saturated core

verdicts.rule: position residual vs brightness or wavelength, Pearson p < 1e-3 (4 tests, Bonferroni)
verdicts.detail: strongest: Dec vs wavelength, r = -0.17, p = 2.1e-01

verdicts.rule: 5-parameter fit (offset, proper motion, parallax) with no catalogue input; reliable only if the target is unsaturated (<50% of epochs with a flagged core), shows no photocentre shift, and the field stars' fitted parallaxes agree with Gaia (<=10% beyond 3 sigma, z spread < 2); detected if >= 3 sigma
verdicts.detail: parallax 975 ± 38 mas (Gaia 547.0, z = +11.3); saturated core in 100% of epochs

verdicts.rule: Gaia field stars through the same pipeline: <=10% with |z|>3 and z spread < 2

caveats: The target is ~211x brighter than the calibration stars; the photometric floor measured on them may not capture bright-star systematics (non-linearity, saturation, halo). Treat low-amplitude variability as unconfirmed.
Proper-motion errors were scaled by 1.6 (sqrt of reduced chi2) because the positional scatter exceeds the formal errors.
Some fluxes come from a Gaussian fit to unflagged PSF wings because the core was flagged (e.g. saturated); they are compared only with each other.
Positions are measured with a circular-Gaussian approximation to the PSF on native pixels; the PSF extension is not yet used (ePSF fitting is a planned upgrade).
Fluxes are aperture fluxes without aperture correction; compare only within a wavelength bin.
A significant motion or variability statistic identifies a candidate for follow-up, not a discovery.
Linear-motion reduced chi2 = 2.5 > 2: formal position errors are likely underestimated; treat z-scores with caution.
